explication: agents-ui is a Nuxt dashboard for visually managing Claude Code configuration and running, testing, and monitoring agent sessions. The main user journey is to define agents and skills, organize relationships or workflows, then interact with Claude Code through chat or the CLI and inspect results and usage. The graph preserves the documented marketplace/import, plugin, command, MCP, output-style, and project capabilities. Several UI-to-server links are documented only at product level; those are marked unverified. Unsampled subsystems use exact directory paths from the tree.
